The '''home''' of [[Elscol Loro]]'s [[Parent/Legends|parents]] was located in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Tamarack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cilpar]]. The building was destroyed in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] when it was struck by a direct hit during an attack on Tamarack by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Boren Tascl]], with Loro holding the person who let slip the house's location to the Imperials responsible for "betraying [her] personally."
